gate_result: PASS at HIGH security threshold; not a clean-system verdict
review_scope: Authentication diff before header-name repair; subsequent header repair manually reviewed and covered by route regression.

rows.title: [HIGH_BUG] Fail-open ledger/exchange read overwrites all balances on any I/O error
rows.evidence_boundary: Read and parse errors collapse to empty state; successful sell writes both documents. No injected I/O failure executed in this batch.

rows.title: [HIGH_BUG] Non-atomic two-file commit can desync pool reserves from ledger balances
rows.evidence_boundary: Exchange and ledger commit separately. No crash or second-write-failure scenario executed in this batch.

rows.title: [MEDIUM] "Authenticated" == any freshly minted keypair; unbounded orders/pools re-serialised per request
rows.evidence_boundary: Self-minted signer identities and unbounded order creation are visible. AMM liquidity requires currency balances and non-zero amounts upstream; failed closure is not persisted.

rows.title: [MEDIUM] Process-local NIP-98 replay cache does not span the multi-process ledger it guards
rows.evidence_boundary: Replay cache is process-local; file locking spans processes. No replica experiment run. Single-process deployment or shared replay admission remains required.

rows.title: [MEDIUM] Host-header-derived URL binding + nginx default_server enables cross-service NIP-98 replay
rows.evidence_boundary: Shared URL helper accepts forwarded authority. Cross-service replay and current ingress exposure were not executed. Canonical-origin and trusted-proxy contract need separate validation.

rows.title: [BUG] Unvalidated numeric/currency extractor content (fee_bps, zero amounts, empty query currencies)
rows.evidence_boundary: Pinned trading.rs rejects zero AMM swap/liquidity inputs. Order creation accepts zero values; fee_bps is stored unchanged and subtracted from10000; empty currency policy remains open.

rows.title: [BUG] Blocking flock held across await points on the tokio worker
rows.evidence_boundary: Blocking flock guard remains live across async reads/writes. Contention impact not measured.

rows.title: [BUG] Trade settlement correctness depends on unreviewable upstream (escrow / currency confusion)
rows.evidence_boundary: Pinned dependency is available locally. execute_swap checks both parties by currency before settlement. Order creation has no escrow; currency-confusion/unfunded-settlement allegation is not established.
